requirement: Render initial reveal and muted/shell border states. Acceptance: fixed-clock frames at start/intermediate/end; no replay after tab remount. C03/C17.
upstream_citations: packages/tui/src/component/prompt/index.tsx:1588-1592 highlight(): muted -> theme.border.base; shell -> theme.text.action.primary.selected; else promptDisplay().agentColor ?? theme.border.base

packages/tui/src/component/prompt/index.tsx:1594-1608 agentMetaAlpha createFadeIn + revealedPromptMetadata WeakSet (no remount replay); borderHighlight = tint(theme.border.base, highlight(), agentMetaAlpha())
packages/tui/src/context/local.tsx:128-135 color(id): explicit agent.color wins, else palette[index % len], unknown -> palette[0]
why_not_bounded: CP-09 is NOT a bounded patch. The task framing (add a `color` field + a view setter) would create new helpers with NO live caller, which the landability rule rejects. The real blocker is a missing multi-seam producer chain, all four legs absent: (1) no live selected-agent state - the live loop DISCARDS the only agent-cycle input (InputEvent::AgentCycle -> `continue` at tui_entry.rs:10932, comment 'the live loop has no selected-agent state'); (2) the session's selected agent is never fetched - LiveSnapshot (tui_entry.rs:573-604) and snapshot_from_listing (:1140-1242) parse no `agent` field from /api/sessions, unlike upstream data.session.get(id).agent (local.tsx:95); (3) the agent catalogue that IS fetched (/api/commands) is metadata-only and drops color server-side (configured_commands.rs:80-104 mention_agents emits {name,description,read_only} only; primary/hidden/subagent entries dropped at 97-104), and the CLI parser agent_catalogue_rows (tui_entry.rs:5549-5635) reads only name/description/read_only/aliases into a PageRow with no live selected-agent consumer; (4) set_composer_agent (native_view.rs:1308) has ONLY #[test] callers (:5703,5740,5773) so composer_agent is always None live, and the live border rail home_composer_border_cell_style (tui_entry.rs:2820-2839) paints static (paint_color(palette, Slot::Border), root) with no agent color, no reveal tween, and no muted/shell distinction. Additionally the 9-step categorical scale required by agent_palette (native_prompt_pane.rs:604, scales [[[u8;4];9]]) is not exposed: native_theme_runtime exposes only single-step categorical_colors (:906-910).

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The only agent-catalogue payload DROPS `color` and filters out primary/hidden entries; the CLI never receives an agent color.
missing_seams.required_producer: Emit agent `color` (hex/theme-token) - and, if selection is needed, `mode`/`hidden` - in the /api/commands payload, or a dedicated /api/agents route, matching schema/agent.ts:19-35.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live client never fetches or stores the session's selected agent, so there is no id to resolve a color for.
missing_seams.required_producer: Parse and store the session's live `agent` id from /api/sessions (or /api/sessions/{id}), mirroring local.tsx:95 data.session.get(id).agent.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live loop has NO selected-agent state; the only agent-cycle input is discarded, so there is no live current-agent to color the border.
missing_seams.required_producer: Live selected-agent state in NativeView plus a production dispatch of AgentCycle (and/or Agents-page selection) that updates it.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: Only #[test] callers; composer_agent is always None in the running TUI.
missing_seams.required_producer: A production caller that sets the observed selected agent (and its color) from the live session agent + parsed catalogue.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live rail paints a static Slot::Border; it never calls prompt_highlight/border_highlight and holds no reveal clock, so muted/agent/reveal states cannot be rendered.
missing_seams.required_producer: A live paint consumer that calls prompt_highlight(agent_color)/border_highlight with a per-prompt MetadataReveal alpha driven by the live FrameClock (native_clock.rs:43 now_ms), plus a live `muted` (leader) source.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: Exposes only the single `.200` categorical step; agent_palette(native_prompt_pane.rs:604) needs nine-step scales to pick 400 (new-designs) vs 200.
missing_seams.required_producer: Expose the full categorical hue scales (all 9 steps) so agent_palette can select the correct step.

live_consumer: crates/cli/src/tui_entry.rs:2820-2839 IS the live border painter but paints static Slot::Border; no live path supplies an agent color or a reveal alpha. set_composer_agent, agent_color, prompt_highlight, border_highlight and MetadataReveal have only test callers.
focused_test_plan: No patch. Existing cp07_agent_selection_and_palette_color_are_data_driven (native_prompt_pane.rs:1551) and cp09_metadata_reveal_tweens_once_and_never_replays (:1631) prove the models in isolation; they do not establish a live consumer or producer, so they cannot satisfy the landability rule.
note: A `color` field on the catalogue alone (as the task framing suggests) would be a new helper with no live caller -> REJECTED under the landability rule. See docs/ui-parity/PARITY_STATUS.md:315-316.
